home.caption: Overview: what the agent did, and what is still zero
home.alt: Overview shows one tracked application, one awaiting approval, zero verified submissions and one hundred recorded actions. A next-actions card asks for a resume to work from.
home.provenance: Captured at 1440 by 1000 during the WS-33 console audit on 17 November 2026, against the stored corpus. The account is an audit account, so the counts belong to it.

discover.caption: Discover: a weakened score set is disclosed rather than hidden
discover.alt: Discover lists 50 matches ranked against 8,558 saved jobs. A notice says semantic scoring was unavailable for part of the corpus, so these scores are weaker than a full run. Each row carries a score and an expandable reason.
discover.provenance: Captured at 1440 by 1000 during the WS-33 console audit on 17 November 2026. The notice reports the state of that run; it is not a claim about the ranker's normal output.

tailor.caption: Tailor: one profile, one job, one draft at a time
tailor.alt: Tailor explains that the agent uses only what the resume already says. A list of jobs already matched to the profile follows, one row per job with its most recent score.
tailor.provenance: Captured at 1440 by 1000 during the WS-33 console audit on 17 November 2026. The date in each row is the match timestamp recorded for that account.

review.caption: Review: the promise made before a packet is prepared
review.alt: Two cards. The first says preparing checks the target domain and builds a payload without contacting the employer or submitting. The second says the agent cannot answer unsupported questions, bypass a challenge or submit without a human decision.
review.provenance: A crop of the Review screen's two explanatory cards, supplied with the 22 November 2026 pack and carried forward. It shows interface copy, not a submitted application.
